annotations.title: What owning a product commits you to

description: What owning one product involves, each fact with its source page and date: the maker's return window, who pays return shipping and any restocking fee; the warranty length and what it covers; whether a subscription is needed, its price and the first-year cost where the price and billing period are both stated; the maker's support status as of a stated date; and published recalls, service programs and security-update windows. Optional section narrows the answer to one part.

section.description: Only this part: returns, warranty, subscription, support or programs (recalls and service programs)
